chapter: Arriving in New York: the Nest Club and Harlem nightlife
title: Simon Marrero wins the Rhythm Club bass contest and McKinney's offer
summary: Simon's finger-style bass amazed the Rhythm Club, and McKinney offered him a job in Detroit, while Goldie was sent for to keep him in New York.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: So... Yeah, that's right. So we fooled together... I mean, we were close together, now, and he comes to the house. He goes around to the Rhythm Club every day, because everything was centered around there. And McKinney's Cotton Pickers are in town playing some New England dates. So they got him involved in a rhythm section cutting contest. All the bass players. And Harry would have got (?) to the gig with (?). And Simon went on to play to the amazement of the people in there, because they ain't used to hearing nobody play...

....that kind of bass. There was an old man, Harry Hall, who played bass. And Tizol, Juan Tizol's uncle,, who played bass with the Latin people. And there were two or three other Latin bass players from Cuba who played a three-string bass. But there was nobody played finger bass, you know what I mean; they played the bass with the bow in their hand...

But Simon upset the Rhythm Club. So he came back, he said... He told Paul in the evening, he said, "There's a guy who spoke to me today, whose name is McKinney. He asked me if I want to join his band and go on to Detroit." Paul said, "Do you know who McKinney is?"
"No, I never heard of him." You know, he's down in New Orleans...

So Paul said, "That's McKinney of McKinney's Cotton Pickers. He wants you to join the band. It would be a great thing for you to join." He said, "I don't know if I want to go to Detroit." See, his old lady was Goldie, and Goldie was a fine Creole woman, and Simon wanted to go back to Goldie. So to keep him from going back, they sent for Goldie to keep him up there. They were interested in trying to help(?) him. So he stayed.
